instruction: Combine all .txt files from your vscode project into a single LibreOffice Writer document "complete.docx" on Desktop. Ensure all text has a uniform font size of 10 throughout the entire document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.getWindowsWithTitle('complete.docx'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires merging 5 txt files into a docx and ensuring all text has uniform font size of 10. Evaluator checks: (1) content was merged (word count >= 20), (2) all text runs have the same font size (uniformity), and (3) font size equals 10.

llm_judge_reasons: Coverage is complete: Evaluator checks both requirements - (1) content merging via word_count >= 20 heuristic (33% weight) and (2) uniform font size of 10 (67% weight split between uniformity check and size match).
Getter logic is correct: Extracts font sizes from all text runs, checks uniformity, counts words, and determines content_merged based on word count threshold.
Metric logic is correct: Awards partial credit for three aspects - content_merged (33%), is_uniform (34%), and font_size match (33%).
Postconfig is appropriate: Uses Ctrl+S to save the document before evaluation, ensuring fresh file state.

Semantic weakness in content merging check: The word_count >= 20 heuristic is a weak proxy for verifying that 'all .txt files were combined'. It doesn't verify actual source file content appears in the output - a user could create any 20-word document and pass this check.

No validation of source files: Evaluator doesn't count source .txt files or verify their specific content appears in the merged document, only uses a word count threshold as a proxy for 'substantial content'.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Strengthen content merging verification: Instead of word count >= 20, getter could count the number of .txt files in /home/user/Desktop/doc_proc/ directory and verify the merged document has content from all source files (e.g., by checking for unique strings from each file).
Add metadata about source files: Include in task metadata the expected number of source files and/or sample content from each file to enable more precise verification.
Alternative heuristic: Use a higher word count threshold based on actual source file content analysis, or check for multiple paragraphs/sections as evidence of merging.
